title: +*PEOPLES AND CULTURES OF CHINA
description: Examines Chinese society and culture from an anthropological perspective. Explores dramatic changes in people’s lives as China has transitioned within a few generations from a poor, agrarian society to a socialist revolutionary society and, finally, to the economic and geopolitical power that it is today. Emphasizes China’s changing role in the world as reflected in arts, politics, language, and media.
